title: lindera benzoin
intro: Lindera benzoin, commonly known as spicebush or northern spicebush, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and stress. The health benefits of Lindera benzoin are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Lindera benzoin include essential oils, particularly linalool and β-caryophyllene, as well as glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
